notes: Minimal pass: only funding and leadership from press releases were collected. Headcount, postings, SEDAR+/CSE filings (MD&A), Wayback and OpenAlex were not checked for lack of time.

The February 2025 private placement was paused 'due to tariff uncertainty and public market volatility' (2025-06-10 release); the directors' CAD 1.2M loan bridged the gap, then a CAD 0.25/share placement (expanded to up to CAD 6.5M) closed in two tranches in Sep and Oct 2025. The tranche amounts come from Techleap summaries citing Stockwatch, not the company's own releases.
A TipRanks item describes an undated non-brokered placement of up to CAD 3M at CAD 0.40 per unit; not placed in the timeline.
Founding year not verified. Website telescopeinnovations.com confirmed live 2026-10-09 (homepage only; careers not checked).
Public-company status makes this the best-documented company on paper (quarterly MD&A, CSE Form 9 notices), so a follow-up pass could add audited headcount and every financing.
